results.title: Shaky finish drops Pagdanganan to joint 39th after 69
results.description: Bianca Pagdanganan wavered at the finish and settled for a three-under 69, slipping into a share of 39th but remaining comfortably within the projected cut line after the opening round of the Wildhorse Ladies Golf Classic on Friday (Saturday Manila time) in Pendleton, Oregon.
